mentions.name: Kernel
mentions.description: This app is a GSAT vocabulary study tool for Taiwanese students, turning cram-school-style structure into software that tracks what users are about to forget and schedules what to review next.
mentions.problem: Exam prep often means paying cram schools for structure and linear repetition.
mentions.audience: Taiwanese students preparing for the GSAT exam
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Kernel, a GSAT vocab study app for Taiwanese students. A lot of exam prep still means paying cram schools for structure and linear repetition. We’re trying to turn that structure into software that knows what you’re about to forget and what to review next.

evidence.value: Working on Kernel, a GSAT vocab study app for Taiwanese students. A lot of exam prep still means paying cram schools for structure and linear repetition. We’re trying to turn that structure into software that knows what you’re about to forget and what to review next.
